acquisition method: A top-12 data-dependent method was used for mass data acquisition.
alkylation reagent: free-thiols alkylated with an excess IAM prior to mass spectrometry analysis
alkylation concentration: treated for 1 h with 15 mM IAM.
cleavage agent: digested overnight at 37 °C using sequencing grade trypsin
collision energy: Normalised collision energy was used in a stepped mode (25, 30 and 35).
fragmentation method: Precursor fragmentation occurred in a high-energy collision dissociation cell
instrument: coupled to a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer
labeling: The mass spectrometry proteomics data have been deposited to the ProteomeXchange Consortium via the PRIDE partner repository with the dataset identifier PXD027729.
ptm: methionine oxidation (variable); cysteine di and tri oxidation (variable); cysteine carbamidomethylation (variable); Ebselen covalent modification (+274.985 Da) in cysteine/lysine (variable)
methionine oxidation, cysteine di and tri oxidation, cysteine carbamidomethylation, and Ebselen covalent modification (+274.985 Da) in cysteine/lysine were defined as variable modifications.
